verdict.rationale: Rainforest explicitly states platforms retain full ownership of payment and merchant data and 'may export it at any time' (rainforest-docs-34), and the API is documented via OpenAPI 3.1.0 (rainforest-docs-26) allowing programmatic data retrieval. However, there's no explicit mention of specific open export formats (CSV/JSON dumps) or a dedicated bulk-export/account-closure workflow. Missing for 10: explicit open-format export documentation (e.g., JSON/CSV export tooling), independent verification of the export process, and details on exporting beyond API pulls.
